title: Unbound planned tasks prematurely require every future source file
observedContext: Canonical revision15 maps PLATFORM-006 READY with candidate:null. Its contract explicitly includes new files that are not created until authorized implementation.
reproduction: node tools/brain.mjs validate returns INVALID ENOENT for packages/composition/src/workspace-closure.ts while it remains absent.

affectedCode.finding: validate checks every allowedPaths file before considering checkpoint/task state.
context computes a materialized candidate before reading its unbound task state.

independentReview.conclusion: Workflow lifecycle inconsistency for planned additions. Not atlas source drift and not proof the Knowledge implementation failed.

repairRequirements: Distinguish a declared, unbound plan from an existing materialized candidate in validate and context.
Preserve lexical path confinement, existing-parent symlink/junction checks and strict source/evidence matching for bound candidates and acceptance.
Never create placeholder product files merely to satisfy Brain validation.
Test READY with planned absent files, later materialization, unsafe paths, and bound/accepted missing-source failure.
coordination: The accepted current BRAIN-001 maintenance candidate includes brain-core.mjs and its workflow tests. Editing them also triggers STALE_ACCEPTANCE until a new qualified maintenance checkpoint is published. Shared checkpoint ownership remains with the active platform coordinator; this atlas audit did not rewrite that acceptance or the platform task.
